senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; בתל, √בת, to separate; cmp. בתר; v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) [retired, untouched,]

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:14">Tosef. Shebi. III, 14</cite> sq. <he>שלש ב׳ הן</he> b’thulah is used in three ways, <he>בְּתוּלַת אדם וכ׳</he> of a human being (virgin), of soil (unbroken), and of sycamores (untrimmed); <cite ref="Niddah 8b:34">Nidd. 8ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 49ᵃ.

<cite ref="Yevamot 61b:13">Yeb. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>אין ב׳ אלא נערה</he> under b’thulah (in a legal sense) a girl between twelve and twelve and a half years is meant, v. <cite ref="B00092"><he>בַּגְרוּת</he></cite>. Ohol. XVI, 4 <he>עד שמגיע … לב׳</he> until he reaches a rock or unbroken ground.
<cite ref="Shabbat 90a:7">Sabb. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>בתולת הוורד</he> a closed rose (Var. quot. in Ar., a. Ms. O. <cite ref="Q02166"><he>פְּתִילַת</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4:13">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ ציימנית</he> an ascetic maid (retired from social pleasures); <cite ref="Sotah 22a:9">Sot. 22ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="R00517"><he>צליינית</he></cite>) <he>ב׳ ציילנית</he> a prayerful (bigoted) maid; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (only in pl.) the two posts supporting the beam in the wine-press (Lat. gemelli, sorores).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:5">B. Bath. IV, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 67b:3">67ᵇ</cite>), expl. <he>כלונסות</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 418:1">Yalk. Ex. 418</cite>. Ib. I Kings 185.
